judgements.justification: A had no detractor to set aside, and B's AC did not discard c6Mx's 4 but echoed its fragmentation point in a poster decision.
Only B's Brcd remarked that a conference may not be the best venue, and it still gave 7; nobody held a score or tier down on audience or venue fit.
Neither meta-review misreports the record: A's omits weaknesses but states nothing false, and B's fragmentation summary matches c6Mx, MuL7 and Brcd.
B's reviewers stayed silent, but the authors conceded c6Mx's two main points, so the unrevised 4 rested on points the response did not answer away.
A's unchecked reviews (KmGd 6, Dzyq 7) did not lift the mean above its one checked review, vTqw's 7; the spotlight came from the AC, not those scores.
Neither committee split evenly: A was 7, 6, 7 and B was 7, 4, 8, 6 with one detractor, and B's AC followed the scores.
The authors gave both committees the same account, including that [ZCH+20] has the better l2 rate; only the questions asked differed.
B's novelty critique rested on a correct account of prior work ([FKT20] smoothing, [ZCH+20] rate), and A made no novelty verdict on prior work.
A's spotlight rests on scores of 7, 6, 7 with no reviewer arguing for a higher tier, and the meta-review only recommends acceptance with no reason for spotlight.
B's critics objected to novelty, batch sizes and fragmentation from within the field's own premises, not to the paper's framing from a neighbouring field.
B had the engaged champion (MuL7's 8) yet got the lower tier, and A had no critics for a champion to argue against.
Neither committee rejected the paper or judged promised revisions too large for camera-ready; both accepted.
B's AC mentions unrecorded discussion but follows the visible scores, and A's AC relied on its own reading, not an off-record assessment.
TpjV listed missing experiments for a theory paper, but B's decisive concerns were novelty and fragmentation, which are not standards tied to the contribution type.
c6Mx's held 4 rests on incrementality of the GLL result and the weaker l2 rate, which are central to the contribution, not peripheral.
